_comment: Layout, sizing and motion for toggle-switch. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here. Figma: toggle-switch component set (14291:131527) — Track 51x31, Knob 27x27 at x:2/x:22, y:2.

base._source-track-width: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 51px is a fixed frame width on the Track, and semantic.spacing has no 51 step
base._source-track-height: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 31px is a fixed frame height on the Track, and semantic.spacing has no 31 step
base._source-knob-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 27px is a fixed frame size on the Knob, and semantic.spacing has no 27 step
base._source-transition-duration: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md semantic has no motion/duration group; the knob slide is authored in code
base._source-transition-timing: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md semantic has no motion/easing group

_verified_from.scope: both variants (active=true / active=false), every child node and effect
_verified_from.result: Track 51x31 radius 9999; knob 27x27 radius 9999 inset 2 on every side, at x=2 off and x=22 on; on = toggle-bg-green, off = toggle-bg-soft-gray; knob = toggle-fg-white. All match.

_source.knob-shadow: elevation.floating, and it is the right token: Figma stacks two drop shadows on the knob — blur 4 spread -1 offset (0,2) at 6%, and blur 6 spread -1 offset (0,4) at 10%. elevation.floating is `0 4px 6px -1px #0000001A, 0 2px 4px -1px #0000000F`, the same pair. Checked value by value on 2026-08-19.
_source.transition-duration / transition-timing: storybook-local. design.md has no motion group at any tier and Figma declares no motion, so these are the library's own.

_library_additions._note: Figma's set has exactly one property, `active`, with two values. Everything below is the library adding what a real control needs and Figma does not draw. Listed so nobody mistakes them for a reading of the design.
_library_additions.focus-ring-width / focus-ring-offset: Figma draws no focus state. A toggle is keyboard-reachable, so it must show focus — this is an accessibility requirement, not a design decision taken from Figma. Figma should add the variant.
_library_additions.disabled-opacity: Figma draws no disabled state either, but `disabled` is a real prop on the component.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. An icon Figma hides by default belongs in `icons` only when this component implements the state that reveals it; otherwise it is recorded under _figma_gaps instead, so the gate is not asking for a feature nobody built.

nodes.note: This component draws no icon at all in Figma. Recorded so that one appearing later has to be justified rather than slipping in.
